transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting opens today with China's financial regulators announcing new developments. Reported by 东方财富: DeepSeek announces API web search and scraping fees, while multiple A-share tech giants disclose share buyback proposals.
Confirmed by 创业邦: DeepSeek released a new model with super cost-performance capabilities.
Anthropic commits 5% equity stake to a public benefit fund. Confirmed by The Tech Buzz: the commitment is for artificial intelligence safety.
Reported by 蕃新聞: the laptop local artificial intelligence processing era arrives with NVIDIA RTX Spark debuting and AMD FSR 4 closely following.
China considers export controls on artificial intelligence and chips. Still open per Semafor: a U.S. group proposes similar rules amid rising artificial intelligence anxiety.
